svg.title: The Courant Test: 31 of 31 real runs judged correctly
svg.desc: Each of the Courant Test's 31 real OpenFOAM runs as a tile: its worst residual per step, whether its log ends in End, and Courant's verdict. Wrong results accepted 0 of 23; good results rejected 0 of 8.
svg.text: The Courant Test: 31 of 31 judged correctly
31 real OpenFOAM v2406 runs. Each tile is one run's worst residual.
